confidence_notes: Meal, coffee, and draft-beer anchors use October 2026 Los Angeles cost-of-living observations. The cocktail estimate reflects an ordinary bar price at roughly twice local draft beer; wine is estimated at about 1.5 times draft beer because typical full-price restaurant wine data were limited. Hostel and hotel prices are holistic estimates and vary substantially by neighborhood, date, and events.
comparable_city_reasoning: No other city was used; food and coffee use Los Angeles city-specific cost-of-living data, while accommodation is estimated holistically for a large, high-demand U.S. coastal city.
